programme.desc: The remaining chefs are tasked with oven roasting, steaming or deep frying.

programme.desc: For the first time in the competition, the chefs are no longer working on teams and must survive the next cooking challenge on their own.

programme.desc: The remaining chefs are tasked with cooking Cajun dishes that blend southern flare with French influence; the chef who creates the best dish receives a coveted time token that gives them a major advantage in the next challenge.

programme.desc: The final six chefs must cook protein with the bone in, which is no small feat in the essence of time; two chefs fight to the finish in the elimination round, where they are presented with a formation of fish to choose from.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.218: Innovation Melting Pot / Make Up Your Mind Barbazoo
programme.desc: The Barbababies want to invent like Leonardo da Vinci. // The Barbababies must choose between going to the pool or going for a bike ride.

programme.title: Bedtime Stories with Ryan S1 Ep.104: Goodnight &, Hello, You
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares some tales that dare.

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1 Ep.120: The Missing Mammoth: A Holiday Mystery - Special
programme.desc: Everyone's decking the halls to get in the holiday spirit. But Sam and Kit are blasted back in time to the Ice Age and meet some wooly new pals.

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1 Ep.101: The Mystery on the Monsoon Express
programme.desc: Animal detectives Sam and Kit collect all the clues while searching for the slithering suspect who bit an express train's engineer.

programme.title: Deer Squad S4 Ep.416: Cave Invaders / Stone Pangolin Surprise
programme.desc: When Jade is at a party Baron Bite raids the Crystal Caves and causes crystal carnage! // Rammy discovers an ancient Kung Fu move that transforms him into a giant stone pangolin.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S1 Ep.138: Fancy Dress Party
programme.desc: Peppa and George are having a costume party. Peppa is a fairy princess, and George is a dinosaur. Peppa has to pick which of her friends is wearing the best costume.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S1 Ep.139: The Museum
programme.desc: Peppa and her family go to the museum. Peppa imagines herself as a Queen in the King and Queen's room. George imagines being a big dinosaur in the Dinosaur Room.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S1 Ep.140: Very Hot Day
programme.desc: It is a super hot day, and all the mud puddles have dried up, so Peppa and George play in the wading pool.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S1 Ep.141: Chloe's Puppet Show
programme.desc: Peppa and George visit their cousin Chloe's house, where they put on a puppet show about a pig who snores a lot. Daddy Pig and Uncle Pig miss the show as they are too busy snoring.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom S1 Ep.102: Holly's Magic Wand / The Elf Farm
programme.desc: Holly needs her wand to do magic. When she loses it, Ben has to use his elf skills to find it. // Holly goes with Ben and Mr Elf to the Elf Farm. While there, a huge chicken escapes and Holly and the elves have to chase it across the Little Kingdom.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S9 Ep.925: Pups Save the Baby Space Rocks / Pups Save the Eddies and Emmys
programme.desc: When a mysterious storm drops hailstones that hatch into Baby Space Rocks, the Pups must find a way to keep them safe. // A 3-D printer leads to trouble when Eddie and Emmy make 3-D reproductions of themselves and play pranks all over Adventure Bay.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S11 Ep.1115: Pups Save the Lost Penguin
programme.desc: Chickaletta switches places with a Baby Penguin.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 Ep.308: The Crew Builds A Giant Duck Plane / The Crew Builds A Vet Room For Motor
programme.desc: A flock of migrating ducks settles in Builder Cove! It's up to Rubble & Crew to help the ducks start moving south. // Motor doesn't want to visit Dr. Diwa at the Vet Clinic... so the pups build a special space just for her!

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1 Ep.122: The Crew Builds A Giant Dam
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew are on the job to save Builder Cove after a rainstorm threatens to flood the town.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.103: Buzzy Croc / Dream House
programme.desc: Mr. Crocodile worries he'll be caught between his old best friend Buzzy and his new best friend Daisy. // Daisy and Mr. Crocodile's simple treehouse gets complicated when they try to add space for all their friends.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.219: Rebels / Barbascience
programme.desc: Barbidur and Barbalala become little rebels. // But who are the Barbapapa?

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.108: The Competition Prize
programme.desc: The Barbabies win a touchpad. They all want to use it and snaffle it one after another.

programme.title: DORA S3 Ep.305: Dora's Birthday Surprise / Moonlight Fiesta
programme.desc: Dora and Boots find Dora's lost birthday cake and the family throws her a surprise birthday party! // Dora and Boots help La Luna find the Luna Lily so everyone can enjoy the Moonlight Fiesta.

programme.title: DORA S4 Ep.404: The Missing Magical Instruments
programme.desc: Dora, Boots, and Vicky the Vicuña track down missing magic instruments to save Cloud Kingdom!

RAZOR will show you the world's most powerful laser and the world's smallest anti-cancer treatment. It will take you from the weird world of quantum computing to the boundaries of the cosmos. An international team of reporters will follow the guidance of Occam's Razor - the principle that the simplest explanation is the best one. RAZOR will show that we are already ""living in the future"!
